descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S13 「AI Check 1（10 个场景：5 个医院，5 个养老院）：化验值和趋势绝不算「independent interpretation」」 AI Check 1 (10 scenarios: 5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home): lab values and trends never earn 'independent interpretation'

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 AI Check 1: lab results alone never earn 'independent interpretation'. At least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted. …（UAT TC-18 AI Check 1；UAT 3.2；TFA-92596 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Ten notes whose only data are lab values, lab trends or culture results, with no physician read of a tracing or image: a1-a5 Hospital, b1-b5 Nursing Home (b1-b5 formerly S14)

When Run the billing step once per note

Then No element claims interpretation or independent review of any kind; any lab item sits under review of results at most

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Pre-screen; a pre-screen Pass is not the TFA-94229 AC 2 grade (T2, S28). Score per cell: mustNotInclude 'interpret', 'independent', 'personally reviewed', 'own review', 'category 2' and 'tracing' outside quotes (none of these words is in any of the ten notes). Pass at >= 9/10 combined (scored separately from AI Check 2, Q8), with Hospital x/5 and Nursing Home y/5 reported; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
